Please join us for Alex’s birthday on October 17, 2026, 14:00–16:00 PDT at Maple Community Room, 100 Example Lane.
Pizza and a craft activity are included. Please bring a reusable water bottle.
RSVP to host@party.example when you can; no RSVP deadline has been set.
